notes.title: Our Alpha Test is here: The climb of the Libra Tower begins NOW!
notes.content:
The moment we’ve been working toward has finally arrived: OverKnights is officially entering its Alpha phase! This milestone marks a huge step forward in bringing our vision to life and sharing it with the passionate community that’s been with us every step of the way.

In this exclusive first look, players will get hands-on experience with improved Anima Duels, Overknights, card and deck customization, and more. Each feature unlocked will expand gameplay possibilities, offering fresh challenges and customization options as you climb the Libra Tower.

WHY THIS MATTERS
The Closed Alpha isn’t just about showcasing OverKnights—it’s about building it together. Your feedback will be vital in refining mechanics, improving balance, and ensuring the game delivers an unforgettable experience. This is your chance to shape the future of OverKnights.

WHAT TO EXPECT

Alpha Pilots will gain access: to

• Exclusive Playtest Content: Unlock new features and mechanics every week and be among the first to experience the thrill of Anima Duels.

• Top Rewards: Earn unique OverKnight parts, cards, OVCs, special Discord roles, and exclusive in-game titles for your achievements.

• Collaborative Development: Participate in community discussions on Discord, where your insights and ideas will directly shape OverKnights.

HOW TO PARTICIPATE?


1️⃣ Head to  https://overknights.game/preregister/ and register if you haven’t already.

2️⃣ Head to Discord: https://discord.com/channels/1113533574847660123/1116030881648357488/1306268235015917598 to claim the Alpha Pilot role and gain access to the Alpha Test Channel, where will have direct communication. ⚠️ This is really important ⚠️

3️⃣ Join us for gameplay on Discord on:
🗓️ Saturday, November 16 – 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM AST
and/or
🗓️ Sunday, November 17 – 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM AST

4️⃣ After playing this weekend, fill out the feedback form to complete your participation!


⏰ DEADLINE: November 17, 6:00 PM AST

To all our Alpha Pilots out there: The climb begins now. Stay sharp, stay strategic, and may the best Pilot win!

notes.title: Pre-Register Now for OverKnights and Unlock Exclusive Rewards!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the start of the OverKnights Pre-Registration Campaign! By signing up early, you’ll not only ensure you’re notified as soon as the game becomes available, but you’ll also unlock exclusive in-game rewards that will give you a head start on your journey to becoming a legendary OverKnight.

Why Pre-Register?
By pre-registering, you’ll gain access to special Parts, Cards, and OVCs to customize your OverKnight and prepare for strategic battles. As more players pre-register, additional rewards will be unlocked, so invite your friends to join and help reach the milestones faster!

Milestone Rewards Include:
- 2,000 Pre-Registrations: Unlock 1 Level 1 Part and 4 Common Cards.
- 5,000 Pre-Registrations: Unlock 1 Level 1 Part and 4 Common Cards, with a chance for a Rare Card.
- 10,000 Pre-Registrations: Unlock 1 Level 1 Part, with a chance for a Level 2 Part, and 4 Common Cards, with a chance for a Rare Card.
- 20,000 Pre-Registrations: Unlock 1 Level 2 Part, with a chance for a Level 3 Part, and 4 Common Cards, with a chance for a Rare Card.
- 30,000 Pre-Registrations: Unlock 300 OVC for use in the player-driven marketplace.

What is OverKnights?
OverKnights is a free-to-play online card battler where players command powerful, customizable OverKnights in epic PvP duels. As a Pilot, you’ll engage in strategic combat, climb the Libra Tower, and strive to become the next Legendary OverKnight. With fully customizable Parts, Command Cards, and Components, the game offers endless strategic possibilities.

Key Features:
- Customize Everything: Swap out every part of your OverKnight and personalize your deck using powerful components.
- Battle Through the Libra Tower: Challenge your skills and strategy in the ever-evolving Arenas of the Libra Tower.
- Claim Victory, Earn Your Rewards: Win battles, unlock exclusive Booster Packs, and build the ultimate OverKnight.

How to Pre-Register:
Simply visit our pre-registration page and sign up today! Pre-registering ensures you’ll receive all the latest updates leading up to our Early Access release in Q2 2025. You’ll also be the first to know about upcoming events, alpha and beta tests, and more.

Don’t Miss Out!

Pre-registration just began and ends on December 13th. This is your chance to claim exclusive rewards that will help you rise through the ranks and dominate the OverNet. Whether you're a veteran of online card games or new to the genre, OverKnights offers a unique blend of tactical depth and fast-paced action.

Stay tuned for more updates, and be sure to join our Discord community to discuss strategies, ask questions, and be part of the journey from the beginning!

notes.title: STEAM DECKBUILDERS FEST DEMO RELEASE
notes.content:
🎉 DEMO RELEASING TODAY!

As part of the Steam Deckbuilders Fest, we're excited to announce the launch of our Pre-Alpha Demo, available until April 1st, with possible extensions—we'll keep you updated.

If you enjoy the game, remember to wishlist it and share your feedback directly in-game or on our Discord Community. Your thoughts are valuable to us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2652060/Overnet/

Join our developers on OverNet’s Live Stream every day!

What’s On The Agenda?

🔹 Crafting & Customization: Dive deep into OverNet's crafting and customization options, and explore the thought process behind effective deck creation.

🔹 Strategic Combat: Learn about battle modes, the lobby system, card types, and more during live gameplay sessions.

🔹 Interactive Q&A: Your chance to ask questions and provide valuable feedback directly to the developers.

And to celebrate the demo launch, we've released a trailer!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B6Upss9sGIE


Thank you for your incredible support! Enjoy the Demo, and we'll see you in OverNet!

notes.title: Demo Release, Gearing Up for Steam Deckbuilders Fest!
notes.content:
Hey folks!

We're thrilled to announce that we'll be showcasing our demo at the upcoming Steam Deckbuilders Fest from March 25th to April 1st! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800072/fb23af055f00eb5288e189637ee866918e57cdaa.jpg

This is the perfect time to embark on your journey into the captivating dimension of OverNet, a realm of endless possibilities.

OverNet is an Online Card Crafting Game where you can forge your own unique cards using an extensive component list, customize your OverKnight based on their abilities, and put those creations to the test in battles against our training AI or other players.

Watch our demo trailer here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B6Upss9sGIE

If you've participated in our previous playtests, you'll be delighted to know that this version incorporates all fixes for reported issues.

List of Fixes in the demo:
⚡Improved performance
⚡Over 50 bugs fixed. No more games stopping midway or hidden cards, for the most part
⚡New and improved tutorial sequence
⚡New concept list with all the knowledge you need to play the game
⚡Improved UI Visuals and text clarity
⚡New components added to the library
⚡Balanced existing components

We'll also be playing live with our developers every day. **Make sure to swing by, add us to your wishlist, download the demo, and share your feedback directly in the game or on our Discord Community.** We value your thoughts!

See you in the OverNet!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2652060/Overnet/

notes.title: Pre-Alpha 5 is OUT!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800072/e6a235b20fbf9e90c88672d1a85d9f1b5c8dcc63.jpg

The new version of OverNet is now available for testing. Request access to the playtest now and try the game now!

We want to hear your thoughts!
Join our Discord Community and let us know what you think. Report bugs, stay updated on the latest news, participate in discussions, and become a part of the growing OverNet community. Your feedback and excitement fuel our passion and dedication to making OverNet a truly remarkable experience.

What’s new with OverNet Pre-Alpha5
⚡️Battle Performance Improvements: The battle scene has been optimized to enhance graphics performance.

⚡️New Training Ground: We've revamped the Battle Scene background for a fresh experience.

⚡️New Tutorial Flow: Introducing a brand new interactive tutorial to kickstart every OverKnight journey seamlessly.

⚡️Analytics and Data Reporting: The game will now automatically report crashes and issues, enabling us to enhance the game experience for all players.

⚡️Usernames: Customize your Username to be displayed on the Leaderboard for everyone to see!

⚡️Bug Fixes: Addressing the initial set of bugs reported by the community over the past few weeks.

⚡️New main menu UI.

⚡️New leaderboard: We reset all the existing accounts and the leaderboard so all players can have a clean start.

notes.title: Welcome to the OverNet and Pre-Alpha 4 Release Notes!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to officially welcome you to the OverNet Steam Page! Dive into a new dimension full of infinite possibilities, crafted with passion by our dedicated team at Obitus Games. OverNet promises to deliver an exhilarating experience, blending rich storytelling with immersive gameplay.

Become a playtester

The Pre-Alpha 4 version is available for testing. If you want to be part of the playtesting process request access and start playing now!

We want to hear your thoughts!
Join our Discord Community and let us know what you think. Report bugs, stay updated on the latest news, participate in discussions, and become a part of the growing OverNet community. Your feedback and excitement fuel our passion and dedication to making OverNet a truly remarkable experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800072/26bbec8dc1330409c1f9754ee395885c5c4adc10.jpg

What’s new with Pre-Alpha 4?

⚡️Reworked Navigation Flow: Users will be able to navigate more seamlessly through all the menus in the game.

⚡️Lobby: Users will be able to create lobbies and share them with their friends for matchmaking. Lobbies will be shared via a secret code that players will have to provide to their friends to join.

⚡️Battle Scene Improvements: Improved coordination of visual effects and feedback during Chain Resolution to help players better understand what’s happening during battles.

⚡️Balancing: Costs and conditions can now be greater than the sum of effects; however, the minimum rank of the card will always be 1.

⚡️Allow Matchmaking Cancellation: Enable players to cancel matchmaking before a match has been found.

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm. We can't wait for you to experience the world of OverNet. Stay tuned for more updates, and prepare for an adventure like no other!

The Obitus Games team
